steps.text: Asks for the Wine 11 engine r19 or newer, the D3DMetal 3 line, which runs on macOS 14 and later. The game signs in with a Microsoft account through Xbox's sign-in, and on the default engine Wine forgets that sign-in at every start (its credential lookup fails on macOS when the Keychain has no match). The Wine 11 engines carry the fix, the same one that keeps Forza Horizon 6 signed in (confirmed by the reporter of highball-db#707 on r27). Everything installed in the environment stays.
